_note: Kid definitions, max 12 words per sentence. Facts checked against research sheets where they apply.

terms.radiation: Invisible energy. Too much can hurt your body.
terms.dose: How much radiation your body has taken in.
terms.shielding: Thick walls or water that block radiation.
terms.solar flare: A sudden flash of light and energy from the Sun.
terms.solar storm: A burst of energy and tiny particles from the Sun.
terms.regolith: Loose dust and broken rock on the Moon or Mars.
terms.sol: One day on Mars. It is a little longer than an Earth day.
terms.battery: A box that stores power for later.
terms.solar panel: A flat panel that turns sunlight into power.
terms.tau: A number for how dusty the sky is. Higher means darker.
terms.lunar night: A night on the Moon. It lasts about 14 Earth days.
terms.light time: How long a radio message takes to travel. It moves at the speed of light.
terms.ice: Frozen water. We melt it to make drinking water and air.
